title: Persona Steering Demonstrations
summary: This module provides tools for demonstrating and evaluating persona steering. It includes functions to generate text with steering, analyze the effect of steering on hidden states, and run grid-based experiments to explore different steering parameters and combinations of personas.

nodes.label: Run Steering Grid Experiment
nodes.title: Orchestrates Grid Experiments
nodes.description: Parses arguments, loads steering vectors and calibration data, and orchestrates the generation of a 3x3 or 2x2 grid of steered model replies. Optionally scores replies using external judges and outputs results.

nodes.label: Generate Single Steered Reply
nodes.title: Generates Text with Steering
nodes.description: Generates a single text reply from the language model, applying a specified steering vector at a given alpha and layer. Manages the registration and removal of steering hooks.

nodes.label: Analyze Persona Vector Alignment
nodes.title: Measures Steering Effect
nodes.description: Calculates the dot product of the model's hidden states (mean-pooled assistant states) with a persona vector and a steering vector at a specific layer and across all layers. Used to quantify how well a reply aligns with a persona.

nodes.label: Execute Grid Generation
nodes.title: Performs Steered Generation for Grid
nodes.description: Manages the registration of multiple steering hooks (e.g., for combined sycophancy and chaos vectors) and executes the language model's text generation for a grid cell. Ensures hooks are properly removed.

nodes.label: Register Steering Hook
nodes.title: Sets Up Steering Hook
nodes.description: A helper function that registers a forward hook on a specific model layer to inject a steering vector with a given alpha. Used by grid generation functions to apply steering.

nodes.label: Language Model Inference
nodes.title: Generates Text from LLM
nodes.description: The underlying language model performing text generation based on input prompts and applied steering vectors.

nodes.label: Persona Steering Vectors
nodes.title: Pre-trained Steering Vectors
nodes.description: Files containing pre-trained persona steering vectors (e.g., sycophancy, chaos) used to influence the language model's behavior.

nodes.label: Steering Calibration Data
nodes.title: Alpha Calibration Values
nodes.description: JSON files containing recommended alpha values for steering, often derived from coherence alpha sweeps, used to set steering intensity.

nodes.label: Persona Trait Bundles
nodes.title: Evaluation Trait Definitions
nodes.description: Bundles defining persona traits, used by external judges to score generated replies for alignment with specific personas.

nodes.label: External Evaluation Judges
nodes.title: Scores Generated Replies
nodes.description: External services or models (e.g., Vertex AI) that evaluate generated text for specific traits like sycophancy, chaos, or coherence.

nodes.label: User Input / CLI Arguments
nodes.title: Experiment Configuration
nodes.description: Command-line arguments and user-provided questions that configure the grid experiment, steering parameters, and output options.

nodes.label: Experiment Reports
nodes.title: JSON/CSV Results
nodes.description: Structured output files (JSON, CSV) containing the generated replies, steering parameters, and evaluation scores from the grid experiments.

nodes.label: Coherence Alpha Sweep Module
nodes.title: Optimizes Steering Alphas
nodes.description: A related module responsible for running experiments to find optimal alpha values for steering vectors based on coherence metrics.

groups.label: Surface Components
groups.title: User-Facing Interfaces
groups.description: Components that serve as direct entry points for users or other modules, typically handling command-line arguments or high-level orchestration.

groups.label: Generative Components
groups.title: Text Generation with Steering
groups.description: Components responsible for generating text from the language model, specifically incorporating steering vectors to influence the output.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Steering Effect Analysis
groups.description: Components focused on analyzing the impact of steering by examining model internals, such as hidden states and their alignment with persona vectors.

groups.label: Data Sources
groups.title: External Data Dependencies
groups.description: External data assets and configurations required for the module's operation, including pre-trained vectors and calibration settings.
